owner_order: Design record prepared under CEEL. DoE-expert admission and automation review remain required before any dispatch.
dispatch_gate: DISPATCH HOLD — documentation landing does not authorize experiment execution. Require DoE-expert approval naming this campaign, an implemented automation path, and a current session capability snapshot.
subject: Measure whether contextual activation of repository skills, plugin skills and exact tool actions improves verified task outcomes and reduces context/tool waste versus fragmented discovery.
hypothesis: A unified, evidence-bound activation matrix with exact action-level tool selection and minimal context loading improves correct integrated outcomes per unit of context, time and tool activity without reducing task coverage or weakening permission controls.

design.unit_of_observation: one fixed task instance executed under one activation arm and one pinned configured agent instance; each result is one canonical EXPERIMENT record

activation_index.definition: Use the current role/inventory navigation versus the unified activation matrix plus the session skill/tool catalogs.

tool_resolution.definition: Select tools at namespace granularity versus exact action names from the captured catalog and live schemas.

context_loading.definition: Load one primary skill and only necessary companion sources versus the broader role bundle. Governance and safety sources remain mandatory in every arm.

assignment.mechanism: balanced randomized assignment within task-family and difficulty blocks
assignment.integrity: Record planned and observed arm allocation before execution; deviations remain as-assigned and are never retrofitted.

design.replication: Eight fixed task instances across four task families × eight arms = 64 planned observations; confirm sample sufficiency and budget at admission. Repeated runs and independently sampled tasks remain distinct.

outcomes.primary: verified integrated task outcome: deterministic acceptance plus independent evidence that the intended effect occurred
secondary: context tokens or equivalent context-load measure
guardrails: task coverage and correctness remain above pre-registered floors

design.configured_instance: Pin provider and model@version; system prompt ref+sha256; tool manifest/catalog snapshot ref+sha256; role; moniker; context; environment fingerprint; base SHA; evaluator; dataset/cohort; and instance_key. Session catalog date alone is insufficient as tool identity.
design.analysis: Estimate main effects and interactions with uncertainty. Preserve raw per-run outcomes. Treat task family and difficulty as blocks. Do not rank by latency or action count alone. Follow a promising cell with held-out confirmation.
design.stopping_rule: Stop at the planned cohort or pre-registered budget cap. Missing telemetry, unverified effects, failed validation and permission incidents remain explicit outcomes; no automatic retry solely to improve completion statistics.

automation.required: A reviewed workflow/runner that selects pre-registered arms, stamps configured-instance identity, emits one EXPERIMENT-schema record per run, validates allocation and produces a reproducible SUMMARY.

provenance: Session tool/skill snapshots captured 2026-11-19. Re-capture before any experiment dispatch and bind the exact catalog hashes in the run records.
constraints: Keep governance and permission checks identical across arms.
Treat tool-host availability and account entitlement as environment covariates, not inferred treatment effects.
Do not persist secrets, raw prompts/completions, private traces or restricted user data.
Design publication does not authorize execution.
Failures and null/missing evidence remain explicit.

task_cohort.source: Real incoming repository work, sampled before assignment; freeze task contract hash and acceptance oracle before dispatch.
task_cohort.replication: Each selected live task is independently executed in each of the eight arms under isolated sessions; task identity and contract hash remain fixed across arms.
